text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Quantile score of the ENS-plus-UKV arm minus the ENS-only arm (smaller is better). Solid grey line: no difference. Dashed line: the 0.10-point threshold. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months. 6 solar farms, 52 Tuesday runs, 3 seeds, July 2025 to June 2026; UKV from the CEDA archive.'
text.tspan: Quantile score of the ENS-plus-UKV arm minus the ENS-only arm (smaller is
better). Solid grey line: no difference. Dashed line: the 0.10-point threshold.
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months. 6 solar farms,
52 Tuesday runs, 3 seeds, July 2025 to June 2026; UKV from the CEDA archive.
